project.name: host/host-parent
project.description: Parent of the host-space modules — the counterpart of osgi/bundle-parent. Inter-module versions (the Pulumi-generated incus SDK, the pulumi-edge pair, and every rke2lab artifact) are managed centrally in build-parent's single dependencyManagement, inherited here; this parent adds no dependencyManagement of its own. Plugin versions (shade, exec) live in build-parent too — they are not host-specific (netplan and osgi/manifests shade exec jars as well); only the per-module shade/exec <configuration> is local to each consumer.
